text: dsh-plugin-audit 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件生态管理扩展：它把 GitHub 上标记为 dsh-plugin 的仓库同步到本地目录，查询对应 npm 包，并按维护、文档、npm 和生态收录情况生成评分。它在 DSH 中注册同步、排行榜、单个插件报告和评分历史工具，也把摘要投影到会话供网页侧栏展示。你可以按评分、星标、更新时间或名称浏览插件，查看仓库报告、评分变化以及近期涨跌项目。适合想在 DSH 内了解插件生态并比较项目状态的用户。首次同步可选配置 DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN 以提升 GitHub 搜索额度；目录和历史数据保存在本机。

dsh-plugin-audit syncs GitHub dsh-plugin repositories into a local catalog, checks npm packages, and scores entries by maintenance, docs, npm, and ecosystem signals. Tools provide rankings, reports, and score history; a web panel shows a summary. A GitHub token is optional.

dsh-plugin-audit 的功能「同步插件目录」：从 GitHub 搜索 dsh-plugin 主题仓库并查询匹配的 npm 包。通过 audit_sync 工具触发，可增量继续同步并返回新增、更新和目录统计。
dsh-plugin-audit 的功能「排行榜和插件报告」：按健康评分、星标、更新时间或名称查看本地目录，也可按仓库名查看单个插件的评分说明。分别调用 audit_top 和 audit_plugin，结果包含排名或报告内容。
dsh-plugin-audit 的功能「评分历史」：记录每次同步时的评分快照，并按单个仓库展示时间线，或列出一段样本窗口内分数上升和下降最多的项目。调用 audit_history 可选择 timeline 或 movers 模式。
dsh-plugin-audit 的功能「网页排行榜摘要」：在会话投影中汇总插件数量、已评分数量、npm 包数量、警示数量和前列项目，网页面板读取该摘要并显示排行。

text: dsh-audit README · dsh-plugin-audit — 插件生态体检（Plugin Health Audit for DSH）：**v0.4 (真插件校验 / topic-tag farming filter):** deep scan now verifies a repo is actually a DSH plugin — presence of `cordis.patch.yml`, `dsh.bundle` in package.json, or a plugin entry file. Repos with none of these are flagged `not-plugin` (medium) and **capped at grade C**, no matter how healthy they look. The npm probe also detects whether the published package declares `dsh.bundle` (installable via `dsh plugin add`). This filters the ~half of the topic that is old projects or tag farming.

dsh-audit README · dsh-plugin-audit — 插件生态体检（Plugin Health Audit for DSH）：**Security (v0.2) is a veto, not a weight:** `audit_scan` static-scans a
plugin's package.json install scripts, shell scripts, and entry sources for
remote-code-execution, encoded commands, rc persistence, obfuscation, and
exfiltration to non-allowlisted hosts. High/critical findings land in the
`flags` contract → **grade D**, no matter how healthy the other signals look.
Each finding carries evidence; the scanner is deliberately conservative.

text: dsh-audit README · Compatibility：Tool schemas are validated against the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` value-schema DSL at plugin load (checked against dsh-tools 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.1-rc.2). Earlier releases used JSON-Schema `required` at the root of `output.schema` and closed nested objects without declared properties, which made the host abort the whole profile boot with `unsupported JSON schema: schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL` and could reject the tool's own results. Current releases fix both; if an affected version left your DSH unable to start, remove the plugin from the profile (or upgrade) — no data is lost.

dsh-audit README · Features：| Feature | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `audit_sync` — sweep the topic, probe npm, re-score (incremental, rate-limit aware) | ✅ stable |
| `audit_top` — leaderboard by score / stars / newest / name, category filter | ✅ stable |
| `audit_plugin` — full report card with evidence notes | ✅ stable |
| `audit_scan` — per-plugin static security scan (files → findings → veto) | ✅ stable (v0.2) |
| `audit_history` — score timeline per repo + biggest gainers/losers | ✅ stable (v0.5) |
| Star trend in maintenance signal (from rolling history snapshots) | ✅ stable (v0.2) |
| `auditSummary` session projection + composer-dock leaderboard | 🧪 experimental (loader-format client bundle) |
| Optional periodic sync (schedule service) | 🧪 guarded |
| Seed catalog from the awesome-dsh-plugin list (1018 plugins) | ✅ stable |

dsh-audit README · How it works：- One Cordis plugin: host face (`lib/index.js`) registers tools + projection + optional schedule;
  browser face (`lib/client.js`) renders the dock; `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the row.
- Sync pulls `GET /search/repositories?q=topic:dsh-plugin` (100/page), probes
  `registry.npmjs.org/<name>` with bounded concurrency, then upserts into a JSON
  catalog. Rate-limit-aware: stops early when the search budget runs low and
  resumes next time; failed probes keep the previous values.
- Storage: `dataDir` (default `$DSH_HOME/dsh-plugin-audit` or `~/.dsh/dsh-plugin-audit`):
  `catalog.json` + `meta.json` + `history.json` (rolling star snapshots for future trend tiers).
- All writes are atomic (temp + rename); corrupt files fall back to empty instead of crashing.

dsh-audit README · Install：The package declares `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }`, so it goes
through DSH's official plugin management:

```bash
dsh-audit README · from a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-audit

dsh-audit README · or after publishing to npm：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-audit
```

Restart DSH. The `audit_*` tools are registered host-wide; the leaderboard dock appears
in the web UI on a web profile.

dsh-audit README · First sync：Give the agent a GitHub token (search API: 30 req/min vs 10 anonymous) and ask it to
`audit_sync`, or configure it:

- `dataDir` — catalog location (empty = default)
- `githubToken` — or env `DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- `syncIntervalHours` — periodic sync (0 disables; requires schedule service)
- `npmProbe` — probe npm registry (default true)

dsh-audit README · Standalone (outside DSH, for testing / CI)：```bash
node scripts/seed.mjs                       # build data/catalog.json from the awesome list checkout
node scripts/sync.mjs --token <gh-token>    # real sync, no DSH needed
node --test test/                           # run tests
```

dsh-audit README · Development notes：- Tests are fully offline (fake `fetch` injected) — `node --test test/` needs no network.
- Data model: one catalog record per repo (`repo`, `stars`, `pushedAt`, `license`,
  `archived`, `npm`, `curated`, `addedAt`, `score`, `flags`, …). See `lib/audit.js`
  `repoToRecord` and `lib/scoring.js`.
- The `flags` array is the extension contract for the security tier (v0.2).

dsh-audit README · Roadmap：- v0.3 — open data export (JSON) so other marketplaces can cite the scores
- v0.4 — appeal/comments channel per plugin
- v0.5 — batch scan scheduling (scan the top-N by stars on each sync) + transitive-dependency signals
